authoring: Scripted native Blender geometry; no external provider or paid generation
coordinates: runtime X right Y up +Z into alcove, origin centered at entrance floor
landing: z=3.97..4.95; final tread ends at z=3.97
texture_source: Existing project 1024 px tileable PBR maps, deterministically resized to 512 px and packed in the source blend and GLB; base color sRGB, normal and ORM linear
reimport: Blender 5.2.3 GLB reimport checks roots, sockets, bounds, budgets, stair contacts, unlit black material, 15 wood-versus-liner, 24 aperture/sill, 33 edge coverage and 12 stone infill samples per flight. The sill samples verify wood through z=4.93 and black from z=4.94.
illumination: Visual sconces only; runtime owns lighting
bakes: Existing tileable PBR maps, no high-to-low bake or lightmap
approval: Export geometry, Blender preview and Quest 3 Browser checks passed for this candidate. Owner personal playtest pending.
visual_review: Quest 3 Browser rendered both flights in a normal run and in the showcase. The walnut landing meets each closed door. Walkway samples reached continuous surfaces from the room threshold across the treads to the sill, with black in the recess beyond the leaf.
rail_contact: Per flight, 18 posts penetrate stringer axes by at least 0.039999 m; six landing feet and anchors overlap landing by at least 0.019999 m.
rear_door: Hinged leaf, pull and sign move with named DoorPivot. Leaf clears each jamb by 2 mm; lintel underside sits 5 mm above the closed leaf. Side and cap liner start at z=4.815, behind the front wood plane at z=4.75. Closed leaf spans z=4.825..4.915 and meets the landing height. Black sill begins at z=4.935, 20 mm behind the leaf, overlaps the landing by 15 mm and sits 1 mm above it. Wall sides and horizontal infill meet at x=+/-0.645 m; rear black panel overlaps the cap.
door_clearance: Blender evaluated world-space BVH checks of moving leaf meshes against jambs, rear wall, lintel and recess at closed and 5-degree increments through 75 degrees. Jambs terminate at the lintel underside.
surface_contact: Each riser is a vertical face 3 mm behind its tread boundary (z=0.913+0.34i) without horizontal caps. Ascending supports begin 6 mm behind the boundary. Threshold ends z=0.91, treads span z=0.91+0.34i to 1.25+0.34i, and landing begins z=3.97.
preview_provenance: Blender 5.3 EEVEE, using scripts/assets/render-stairwell-review.py on the packed candidate blend. Four open-door front and oblique views use preview-only camera and lights; the runtime supplies dynamic sign text and lighting.
frame_overlap_regression: The previous export fails: the front ray at x=-0.615 and landing+0.7 hits both wood and black at the same depth. Current export passes 15 front and oblique frame-versus-liner rays per flight.
sill_regression: The previous GLB fails the tracked sill check at z=4.76 where the black recess covers the landing. The current export samples wood through z=4.93 and black at z=4.94, 5.0 and 5.5 on both flights.
